items.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: I found a Freddie Keppard record

ctx.x: Because it was something you had to really aspire to get and figure out how to get and carry the 78s home and all that stuff.

Oh yeah. Junk shopping I remember I was in Washington, D.C. I went to the Army Air Corps, which became the Air Force just as I left, band school. In Bolling Field. And my uncle, Uncle John, the musical one, lived there and his wife was a nurse there at St. Elizabeth or something. And Anacostia was there, the big black neighborhood. And I remember one day I went out and it was unbelievable, there were like rarity, like treasures. God I went out and I found a Johnny Dodds Paramount record in very good shape. You…
